result.question: What warning did Zebul send to Abimelech about Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers?

readings.answer: That Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers had come to Shechem and were stirring up the city against him.
readings.support: Look, Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.

assessments.reason: It restates Zebul’s message from verse 31 that Gaal and his brothers had come to Shechem and were stirring up the city against Abimelech.

result.reason: The answer matches the verse’s wording that Gaal and his brothers had come to Shechem and were inciting the city against Abimelech.
